lines.en: Shell first, I swim slowly.

lines.zh: 一节一节的壳，像串起来的塔。
lines.en: Chamber after chamber, a stacked tower.

lines.zh: 水流从漏斗喷出，推我前进。
lines.en: Water jets from my funnel and pushes me on.
Tentacles probe the way ahead.

lines.zh: 奥陶纪的海洋，也是这样蓝。
lines.en: The Ordovician sea was this blue too.
No rush; fish always come by.

lines.zh: 壳里灌满气，我就浮起来。
lines.en: Gas in my shell lifts me.
A little lower, to check the sand.

lines.zh: 长长的壳在身后划开水面。
lines.en: My long shell cuts a line through the water.
I swim straight as a pen.

lines.zh: 墨迹似的影子落在海底。
lines.en: My shadow inks the seafloor.

lines.zh: 触手一伸一缩，节奏很稳。
lines.en: Tentacles reach and curl in steady rhythm.
I've carried this shell all my life.

lines.zh: 水压变大，我调了调气室。
lines.en: Pressure rises; I adjust my chambers.
Around the coral — don't scrape my shell.
I see the silver flash of small fish.
Slow swimming saves strength; I know.
Who calls me clumsy? I'm light in water.
Hanging in the water, perfectly still.
Tentacles dangle, waiting for fish.
Shell tip down, I rest.
A chamber shifts; I rise a touch.
Something crawls on the sand.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛不好，只靠触觉。
lines.en: My eyes are poor; I rely on touch.
The sea is quiet but for water.
The smell of blood wakes me.
Some weed has settled on my shell.
I'm waiting for a school to pass.
Turning takes effort.
A bubble slips from my shell.
The deep is darker than this.
You're too big for a fish.

lines.zh: 触手先碰到你，我愣住了。
lines.en: A tentacle touches you; I freeze.
I circle once around you.
You can't lift this shell.

lines.zh: 你的气味不像鱼，倒像铁。
lines.en: You smell like iron, not like fish.
I pull my tentacles back, wary.
You're less nimble than I am in water.
Are you after my shell tip?

lines.zh: 我盯着你，虽然看不太清。
lines.en: I watch you, though I barely see.

lines.zh: 别碰触手，那是我吃饭的。
lines.en: Not the tentacles; that's how I eat.
Something struck my shell; dull pain.
I pull in every tentacle.
It hurts; I sink deeper.
A crack in the shell is serious.
I jet out a cloud of sand.
One tentacle is torn short.
I can't flee fast; I can only hide.
I turn about, seeking the wound.
My shell is my home; don't smash it.
Fish scent spreading in the water.
My tentacles are already reaching.

lines.zh: 别抽回去，触手都伸出来了。
lines.en: Don't pull it back; my tentacles are out.

lines.zh: 为了这一口，我游得快了。
lines.en: For this bite, I swim faster.
The stronger the scent, the more I hurry.
Once I curl around it, I won't let go.
Small prey — just one bite.
Blood in water doesn't fool me.
Wave it and I turn with it.
I hit your leg and rebound.
Hard shell, but I take the hurt.
I can't see the path underwater.
Make room; my shell is long.
A tentacle caught you — sorry.
My shell knocks a rock with a dull thud.
You move, and the water pushes me away.
We're jammed in a coral gap.
Back up a little so I can turn.
That one's shell pattern matches mine.

lines.zh: 我喷出一串气泡打招呼。
lines.en: I send a string of bubbles in greeting.

lines.zh: 壳口对壳口，我们并排游。
lines.en: Aperture to aperture, we swim abreast.
Ordovician manners: take it slow.
My scent is all through the water.
Two long shells crossing like a fork.
She swims steadier than I do.
This patch of sea could raise young.
I follow her, quietly.
One tentacle touches hers lightly.

lines.zh: 沙里的小东西，我卷起来。
lines.en: Something in the sand — I curl around it.
Tentacles draw it to my mouth.
Fallen scraps; I waste nothing.
I find things by touch.
I sink to the floor and search.
A shell shard — not much use.
If I can swallow it, I will.

lines.zh: 我捡到了，但看不清是什么。
lines.en: Got it, though I can't tell what.
The water stirs and it drifts away.
Many tentacles make quick work.
A school's shadow — locked on.
That bloody scent is close.
Every tentacle turns the same way.
I adjust my chambers, ready to surge.
This fish won't escape.
I feel the vibration in the water.
Target ahead and to the left.
Shell tip aimed; I close in.
Hold still; I haven't seen you yet.
I've got you, fish.
I ride the current after it.
It turns; so do I.
A jet of water — don't run.
My shell is heavy; the chase tires me.
It's slipped into a crevice.
I wait at the crevice mouth.
A tentacle probes inside.
The scent lingers; it hasn't gone far.
Patience; the fish will tire.
I circle the rock.
Tentacles lash out and seize it!
I ram with my shell tip.
Stop struggling; you can't get free.
A beak hidden among tentacles bites down.
One squeeze, and it's strong.
Blood clouds the water.
I drag it down into the dark.
Once wrapped, I don't let go.
This meal will last me days.
Tentacles release, then coil again.

lines.zh: 我从奥陶纪的海底浮上来。
lines.en: I rise from the Ordovician seafloor.
Shell first, then the tentacles.
Morocco's sea, in a different place.
A splash, and I'm here.

lines.zh: 这里的水，比我记得的浅。
lines.en: This water is shallower than I recall.
I settle slowly to the bottom.
Any fish? I'm hungry.
A long shell slides through the water.
Too bright here; I'm not used to it.
Tentacles test the water's warmth.
Scalding water makes my tentacles curl.
My shell cracks against stone with a thud.

lines.zh: 我在水里却喘不上气，怪事。
lines.en: In water yet gasping — strange.

lines.zh: 水都被震开了，我翻了个身。
lines.en: The blast clears the water; I flip over.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过水面扎进来。
lines.en: An arrow cuts through the water and hits.
That force seeps into my shell, numbing.
No fish; even my shell feels lighter.
No sea beneath me — only emptiness.
